content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://pau.edu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper position is 11th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Junior Field/Lab Helper post is Middle standard with Punjabi as a subject. Candidates must ensure they meet this requirement before applying.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Field/Lab Helper position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Junior Field/Lab Helper post is between 18 years and 63 years. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned for any category in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Field/Lab Helper role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Field/Lab Helper position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 13,486/- per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the PAU Junior Field/Lab Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening, followed by a selection committee interview, and finally, document verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 100/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates. This fee needs to be paid as part of the application process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of Junior Field/Lab Helper in this recruitment drive by Punjab Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the PAU located?
faq.answer: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) is located in Punjab. The specific city for this recruitment is Abohar.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment of Junior Field/Lab Helper at Punjab Agricultural University is 1768-1858.
